text: ４００ねん　むかし　より　わがやに　つたわる　ポケモン　わざ　わざマシン０６には　ごくい！

structure.jp: わがやに　つたわる　ポケモン　わざ
structure.en: a Pokémon move handed down in my family

patterns.name: verb + noun
patterns.span: わがやに　つたわる　ポケモン　わざ
patterns.explanation: A phrase ending in a verb, put right in front of a thing, tells you what kind of thing it is. わがやに　つたわる　ポケモン　わざ = 'a Pokémon move that is handed down in my family'.

patterns.name: 〜より (from)
patterns.explanation: より after a time is a stiff, old-style から: 'from' or 'since'. ４００ねん　むかし　より = 'since 400 years ago'.
